description: This file defines the EntityViewDisplayEditForm class, a Drupal form class for editing entity view display configurations, including methods for building form rows, managing display modes, and integrating third-party settings.

classes.name: EntityViewDisplayEditForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for editing entity view display configurations, providing methods for form building, display mode management, and third-party settings integration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the form class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildFieldRow
methods.description: Builds a form row for a specific field, adding label and formatter options.

methods.name: buildExtraFieldRow
methods.description: Builds an additional form row with a placeholder for label.

methods.name: getEntityDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the view display configuration for a given entity type, bundle, and mode.

methods.name: getDefaultPlugin
methods.description: Returns the default formatter plugin for a given field type.

methods.name: getDisplayModes
methods.description: Gets available display modes for the entity.

methods.name: getDisplayModesLink
methods.description: Provides a link to manage view modes.

methods.name: getTableHeader
methods.description: Returns the table header configuration for the form.

methods.name: getOverviewUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for the entity view display overview page.

methods.name: thirdPartySettingsForm
methods.description: Builds a form for third-party plugin settings.

methods.name: alterSettingsSummary
methods.description: Alters the settings summary for display formatter plugins.
